member.name: RefinedNumberVote
member.para: The case on record. "Die Cyber-Brutzellen" (2026-08-01): the announcement at 7:01:30 fell 27.3 to 43.0 s into a 44.2 s window and came out as a single two-word segment reading "Kapitel 40" at p=0.59, while all ten refinement probes over the same audio read "Kapitel 14", one of them at p=0.99.
